notes: Only 4 boom lengths tabulated (4-section boom). Capacities are rated lifting capacities; hook block mass (270 kg for 30 t hook, 100 kg for 4.0 t) and slings must be deducted (operation note 3, p.11). Above thick line = strength, below = stability; radii include boom deflection. 9.7 m column = fully retracted boom. Outrigger longitudinal span = 3,030 + 3,350 mm (outrigger centres to slewing centre, p.1); transverse max 6.3 m (mid 5.9/5.0 m, min 2.2 m). Operating weight and max hook height not stated numerically in datasheet. DIMS (p.1): overall length 11,245 = 5,725 (boom head to front axle) + 3,500 wheelbase + 2,020; carrier length 7,300 mm -> front axle 1.78 m, rear axle 5.28 m from carrier front; slewing centre 1,750 mm ahead of rear axle (3.53 m from carrier front); boom foot pin 2,460 mm behind slewing centre; tail swing 3,330 mm. wheelDiameter computed from tyre size 445/95R25 (635 + 2x422.75 mm = 1.48 m), not a printed dimension.
